title: Tech Lead/Arquiteto SAP Cloud (S/4hana)
description:
Na Mouts TI , entregamos soluções personalizadas que impulsionam a transformação digital de nossos clientes de maneira ágil, eficaz e descomplicada.

Acreditamos que a tecnologia é um agente de inovação capaz de melhorar a vida das pessoas e queremos você com a gente nessa jornada!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Tech Lead/Arquiteto SAP Cloud (S/4hana) para fazer parte do nosso time!


O que você fará:

  • Liderar o desenho técnico e a arquitetura de soluções SAP Cloud (S/4HANA Cloud e integrações);
  • Ser referência técnica para o time, orientando decisões de design, boas práticas e qualidade de código;
  • Garantir segurança, performance e compliance nas soluções SAP;
  • Apoiar POs e arquitetos na definição de roadmap e estratégias de produto;
  • Conduzir code reviews e evoluções técnicas do stack SAP Cloud;
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, infraestrutura e segurança para entregas robustas e escaláveis.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto Técnico em ambientes SAP Cloud ;
  • Domínio de SAP BTP , SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) , SAP Extension Suite e SAP Build ;
  • Experiência com APIs REST, OData , SAP Cloud Connector e IAS/IPS ;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Perfil de liderança técnica e forte capacidade de colaboração;
  • Inglês avançado (fluente é um diferencial).


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em módulos complementares do ecossistema SAP.

title: Senior Infrastructure Linux Engineer (L2 | Production | Market Data | Remote | Brazil)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible location is Brazil


Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Role Description


We are looking for a skilled Senior Linux infrastructure engineer to maintain and enhance the real-time data systems powering one of the world’s leading investment banks as our customer. You will handle alert and incident management, problem resolution, and system improvements, ensuring uptime and performance for global trading and data services.managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or production support roles
  • Highly skilled in Linux System Administration
  • Experience in Windows operating systems
  • Scripting proficiency (Bash and/or Python preferred)
  • Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.
  • Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must
  • Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices
  • Prior experience in banking, investment, or other financial IT environments is advantageous
  • Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ITRS Geneos , EXEGY (Wombat/Vela) , or Market Data platforms (Refinitiv TREP/RTDS, Bloomberg)
  • Familiarity with AWS ECS , AWS VPC , Google Cloud
  • Experience with GitHub/GitLab and automation pipelines


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits packagr
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Job Description – BDR
description:
Sobre a Montagna Ads

A Montagna Ads é uma agência de performance especializada em tráfego pago e crescimento digital. Nosso foco é ajudar empresas a escalarem seus resultados com estratégia, dados e criatividade.

Somos uma empresa em expansão, com mentalidade de execução rápida, aprendizado constante e foco total em resultado.


Missão do Cargo

O BDR (Business Development Representative) será responsável por nutrir e converter leads em oportunidades reais de venda , atuando como o primeiro ponto de contato comercial da agência.

Seu papel é abrir portas, qualificar potenciais clientes e garantir que o time de fechamento (Closer / Henrico) receba apenas leads com alto potencial de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades
  • Fazer o primeiro contato com leads vindos de formulários, anúncios e indicações.
  • Qualificar os leads de acordo com critérios pré-definidos (segmento, orçamento, urgência, fit com os serviços da agência).
  • Manter a organização do pipeline comercial no CRM, garantindo o registro de todas as interações.
  • Agendar reuniões de diagnóstico com o responsável comercial (Henrico).
  • Aplicar scripts de abordagem e seguir fluxos de cadência de contato (WhatsApp, ligação, e-mail).
  • Monitorar e reportar os principais indicadores (número de leads abordados, taxa de resposta, taxa de agendamento, taxa de comparecimento).
  • Identificar feedbacks e padrões de objeção para otimizar o discurso comercial.
  • Colaborar com o time de marketing para melhorar a qualidade dos leads gerados .


Perfil Ideal
  • Perfil comunicativo e proativo , com facilidade em criar conexão genuína.
  • Capacidade de ouvir, entender e direcionar o lead de forma consultiva.
  • Organização e disciplina para seguir processos e rotinas comerciais.
  • Mente orientada a metas e resultados.
  • Espírito colaborativo, adaptável a mudanças e com vontade de crescer junto com a empresa.


Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento comercial, vendas ou pré-vendas (desejável).
  • Conhecimento básico de marketing digital e tráfego pago será um diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, WhatsApp Business e planilhas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.


Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)
  • Nº de leads contatados por semana.
  • Taxa de qualificação (leads bons x leads ruins).
  • Taxa de agendamento de reuniões.
  • Taxa de comparecimento.
  • Taxa de conversão em clientes (em conjunto com o closer).


Remuneração e Modelo
  • Modelo: Fixo + variável por performance.
  • Faixa estimada: R$ 1.800 a R$ 2.500 fixo + bônus por agendamentos efetivos e fechamentos.


Por que trabalhar na Montagna Ads?
  • Liberdade com responsabilidade: você terá autonomia para testar e propor novas abordagens.
  • Ambiente jovem, colaborativo e em crescimento acelerado.
  • Oportunidade real de desenvolvimento e ganho de performance.
  • Contato direto com estratégias de marketing e funil de vendas reais.


Como será o Processo Seletivo?
  • Triagem de currículo e perfil comportamental.
  • Entrevista com o time Montagna Ads.
  • Dinâmica prática: simulação de qualificação de lead.
  • Entrevista final com os sócios.

title: Job Description – BDR
description:
Sobre a Montagna Ads

A Montagna Ads é uma agência de performance especializada em tráfego pago e crescimento digital. Nosso foco é ajudar empresas a escalarem seus resultados com estratégia, dados e criatividade.

Somos uma empresa em expansão, com mentalidade de execução rápida, aprendizado constante e foco total em resultado.


Missão do Cargo

O BDR (Business Development Representative) será responsável por nutrir e converter leads em oportunidades reais de venda , atuando como o primeiro ponto de contato comercial da agência.

Seu papel é abrir portas, qualificar potenciais clientes e garantir que o time de fechamento (Closer / Henrico) receba apenas leads com alto potencial de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades
  • Fazer o primeiro contato com leads vindos de formulários, anúncios e indicações.
  • Qualificar os leads de acordo com critérios pré-definidos (segmento, orçamento, urgência, fit com os serviços da agência).
  • Manter a organização do pipeline comercial no CRM, garantindo o registro de todas as interações.
  • Agendar reuniões de diagnóstico com o responsável comercial (Henrico).
  • Aplicar scripts de abordagem e seguir fluxos de cadência de contato (WhatsApp, ligação, e-mail).
  • Monitorar e reportar os principais indicadores (número de leads abordados, taxa de resposta, taxa de agendamento, taxa de comparecimento).
  • Identificar feedbacks e padrões de objeção para otimizar o discurso comercial.
  • Colaborar com o time de marketing para melhorar a qualidade dos leads gerados .


Perfil Ideal
  • Perfil comunicativo e proativo , com facilidade em criar conexão genuína.
  • Capacidade de ouvir, entender e direcionar o lead de forma consultiva.
  • Organização e disciplina para seguir processos e rotinas comerciais.
  • Mente orientada a metas e resultados.
  • Espírito colaborativo, adaptável a mudanças e com vontade de crescer junto com a empresa.


Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento comercial, vendas ou pré-vendas (desejável).
  • Conhecimento básico de marketing digital e tráfego pago será um diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, WhatsApp Business e planilhas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.


Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)
  • Nº de leads contatados por semana.
  • Taxa de qualificação (leads bons x leads ruins).
  • Taxa de agendamento de reuniões.
  • Taxa de comparecimento.
  • Taxa de conversão em clientes (em conjunto com o closer).


Remuneração e Modelo
  • Modelo: Fixo + variável por performance.
  • Faixa estimada: R$ 1.800 a R$ 2.500 fixo + bônus por agendamentos efetivos e fechamentos.


Por que trabalhar na Montagna Ads?
  • Liberdade com responsabilidade: você terá autonomia para testar e propor novas abordagens.
  • Ambiente jovem, colaborativo e em crescimento acelerado.
  • Oportunidade real de desenvolvimento e ganho de performance.
  • Contato direto com estratégias de marketing e funil de vendas reais.


Como será o Processo Seletivo?
  • Triagem de currículo e perfil comportamental.
  • Entrevista com o time Montagna Ads.
  • Dinâmica prática: simulação de qualificação de lead.
  • Entrevista final com os sócios.

title: Designer de marketing
description:
Vaga: Designer de Marketing Digital


Regime: PJ

Modelo: Remoto

Local da empresa: São Paulo – Jardim das Perdizes / Barra Funda

Remuneração: R$ 3.500,00 mensais

Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira – horário comercial


Sobre a VetFamily

A VetFamily é uma comunidade global que conecta clínicas veterinárias independentes, oferecendo soluções que fortalecem seus negócios e promovem o crescimento sustentável do setor veterinário.

No Brasil, a VetFamily reúne membros e parceiros da indústria, impulsionando inovação, colaboração e conhecimento com o propósito de fortalecer o mercado veterinário e apoiar clínicas em sua jornada de desenvolvimento.


Objetivo da contratação

Contratar um(a) Designer de Marketing Digital para atuar na estruturação da área de criação interna da VetFamily Brasil, trazendo agilidade à produção de materiais gráficos, campanhas digitais, e-mails marketing e vídeos curtos para redes sociais e canais institucionais.


Contexto da área

Atualmente, a área de marketing é composta por uma coordenadora que lidera as ações estratégicas e aprova as entregas junto a uma agência terceirizada de performance .

O objetivo desta contratação é consolidar o núcleo interno de criação , que será formado por três profissionais: Coordenadora de Marketing, Copywriter e Designer , garantindo mais autonomia e consistência na comunicação visual da marca.


Principais desafios (primeiros 3 a 6 meses)

Nos primeiros meses, o(a) profissional será responsável por:

  • Estruturar o fluxo interno de criação , estabelecendo processos e padrões visuais;
  • Padronizar a identidade visual dos materiais institucionais, promocionais e digitais;
  • Dar suporte direto às campanhas digitais , incluindo e-mails e newsletters;
  • Agilizar a produção de peças gráficas e vídeos curtos , mantendo consistência visual e alinhamento com a estratégia de marketing da marca.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Criação e desenvolvimento de materiais gráficos e digitais , como posts, e-mails, catálogos, folders, apresentações e materiais de campanha;
  • Configuração, disparo e acompanhamento de e-mails marketing e automações ;
  • Criação e atualização de páginas e conteúdos no site institucional (WordPress);
  • Edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais e para o Portal VetFamily;
  • Apoio à produção de campanhas institucionais e nacionais com foco em engajamento e conversão;
  • Gestão do banco de imagens e vídeos , garantindo organização e atualização constante;
  • Sugerir pautas, roteiros e ideias criativas para os conteúdos da marca;
  • Atuar em parceria com o time de marketing e agência externa na execução das ações;
  • Contribuir com melhorias nos processos e metodologias de criação , garantindo eficiência e qualidade nas entregas.


Indicadores de performance (KPIs)

Os indicadores de desempenho serão definidos em conjunto com a liderança da área, considerando:

  • Engajamento das campanhas e comunicações digitais;
  • Consistência e qualidade das entregas visuais;
  • Conversão das ações de marketing por campanha;
  • Cumprimento de prazos e alinhamento com a identidade da marca.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação: Design, Comunicação, Publicidade, Audiovisual ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência: mínimo de 2 anos em design digital;
  • Domínio: Pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere), CapCut e/ou DaVinci Resolve;
  • HubSpot: conhecimento em configuração, disparo e automações ;
  • WordPress: experiência em pequenas atualizações e ajustes visuais;
  • Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em motion graphics, animação e pós-produção;
  • Experiência em storytelling, narrativa visual e branding de conteúdo ;
  • Edição para múltiplos formatos : YouTube, Reels, TikTok, anúncios e vídeos institucionais;
  • Equipamento próprio (computador e softwares de criação e edição).


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, organização e clareza na execução das tarefas;
  • Autonomia e foco em solução;
  • Agilidade e entrega constante;
  • Curiosidade por novas ferramentas e tendências;
  • Comprometimento e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento colaborativo com diferentes áreas.


Cultura VetFamily

A VetFamily é um ambiente colaborativo, leve e orientado a resultados .

Valorizamos a comunicação aberta, a troca de ideias e a agilidade na execução , mantendo sempre um clima de cooperação e confiança.

Nosso propósito é inovar e entregar valor real aos nossos membros , fortalecendo o setor veterinário por meio da colaboração e da transparência.


Valores inegociáveis

  • Transparência nas relações;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe;
  • Responsabilidade e ética nas entregas;


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Portfólio com cases ou resultados mensuráveis;
  • Experiência em startups, agências de marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com produção de vídeos institucionais ou campanhas digitais ;
  • Capacidade de propor novas metodologias e soluções criativas .


Requisitos adicionais

  • Idioma: não é exigido inglês;
  • Viagens: não há necessidade;
  • Trabalho externo: não há captação externa (todo o trabalho é remoto);


Portfólio

É obrigatório o envio de portfólio atualizado , com exemplos de peças gráficas, vídeos curtos, e-mails marketing ou outras produções relevantes para a função.


Resumo do perfil ideal

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional criativo(a), organizado(a) e comprometido(a) , com domínio técnico em design, automação e vídeo , capaz de unir eficiência e estética em suas entregas.


Alguém que valorize o trabalho em equipe, tenha curiosidade por novas ferramentas e contribua para consolidar a presença digital da VetFamily com qualidade e consistência.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,500 - $5,500 USD


Our partner is entering their next phase of growth, expanding their platform and building intelligent systems that transform how banks and credit unions understand and serve their small business customers. They are looking for a hands-on Applied AI Engineer to own everything agentic and generative AI within their organization. As their in-house expert, the selected candidate will design and build systems that integrate large language models into production, support their analytics platform, and lay the groundwork for a next-generation, AI-powered customer experience. They will deliver meaningful impact and have full visibility from day one.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade generative and agentic AI systems, from prompt design and model selection through to orchestration and deployment.
  • Fine-tune and integrate third-party models into their platform and customer workflows.
  • Develop and maintain pipelines, tools, and infrastructure to deliver reliable and scalable AI features.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to deploy and monitor AI services in production.
  • Establish best practices for AI evaluation, safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Help define their AI technical strategy and roadmap.


What You Bring:

  • Strong experience designing, building, and productionizing AI-driven or agentic systems.
  • Deep understanding of LLM orchestration, context management, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience with cloud environments and monitoring or evaluating deployed AI services.
  • Experience working with APIs and SDKs from leading model providers.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with backend integration workflows.
  • Comfort working in small, fast-moving teams with limited technical oversight.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset.


Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with modern frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy.
  • Experience with vector databases, embedding pipelines, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Deep understanding of transformer architecture.
  • Fintech or data-intensive SaaS experience.


What You’ll Get:

  • The opportunity to define and build the AI foundation of a fast-growing startup.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Fully remote work model, with the opportunity to occasionally collaborate in person.
  • Fast-moving, engaging environment with a team that values both ambition and fun.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to make a huge impact in an early-stage company defining a new category in financial technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Fullstack Python/React Engineer (Backend focused)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong emphasis on Python backend development and data engineering to deliver high-impact business intelligence and data visualization solutions. You'll take ownership of the full data pipeline, from designing robust ETL processes in Python to building interactive, user-facing dashboards using modern JavaScript/React frameworks.


Must-have skills:

- Expert-level proficiency in Python and its relevant ecosystem for backend development (Flask, Django, FastAPI) and data manipulation (Pandas).

- Strong working experience with modern frontend development, specifically React and TypeScript/JavaScript.

- Proven experience implementing interactive data visualizations using dedicated libraries (D3.js, Vega, Plotly, or similar).

- Demonstrated ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex features and projects, including architecture, implementation, deployment, and monitoring.

- Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with schema design and query optimization for relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).

- Experience contributing to or actively working with open-source projects, particularly those related to Business Intelligence or Data Visualization.


Nice-to-have skills:

- Direct production experience with Apache Superset .

- Deep expertise in ETL/Data Engineering tools and concepts (Apache Airflow, dbt, cloud-based data warehouses).

- Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Experience integrating Python applications with modern authentication and authorization systems (OAuth2, SSO).


The icing on the Kake:

  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Pessoa Analista Sucesso do Cliente Sênior- Capital Markets
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Garantir que os usuários dos produtos Neoway obtenham os resultados esperados com uma experiência agradável.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Tornar-se um especialista em produtos da Neoway usar esse conhecimento para guiar efetivamente os clientes em direção aos seus resultados desejados;
  • Gerenciar um portfolio de aproximadamente 4-8 clientes Enterprise;
  • Criação e manutenção de relacionamento com alta liderança (gerentes, heads e diretores) das contas mais estratégicas;
  • Identificação, desenvolvimento e aplicação de estratégias de upsell e cross-sell na carteira de Clientes;
  • Acompanhamento e Rotina de Atendimento (Touches, Treinamentos, QBRs, implementação de projetos) e planejamento de Contas (Account Planning);
  • Monitoramento de métricas de sucesso do cliente;
  • Mapeamento e Criação de Cases de Sucesso e Avaliação e Mapeamento de Retorno do Investimento (ROI) dos projetos
  • Desenvolvimento e Apresentação de Estudos Estratégicos para os clientes
  • Integração entre as áreas da companhia para atender solicitações do cliente.
  • Realizar engajamentos contínuos com os clientes para demonstrar valor e rastrear resultados de negócios (reuniões mensais, QBRs, agendas executivas, etc.)


Você fará a diferença se apresentar:

  • Ter atuado em empresa SAAS;
  • Habilidade em planejamento de contas e acompanhamento de projetos;
  • Capacidade analítica para realizar apresentações de estudos estratégicos para os clientes;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar estratégias de upsell e cross-sell;
  • Habilidade em engajamento de clientes para demonstração de valor e rastreamento de resultados de negócios;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de sucesso do cliente e avaliação de Retorno de investimento de projetos;
  • Ter mentalidade proativa e colaborativa, excelente habilidade de gerenciamento de tempo, capacidade de lidar com várias contas e atribuições simultaneamente;
  • Autonomia, Pró-Atividade e Accountability;
  • Inglês fluente.


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / .NET / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, .NET, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.


Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, .NET/C#
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / .NET / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, .NET, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.


Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, .NET/C#
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company

title: Senior Software Engineer - C#
description:
About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop strategies for transitioning from legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer with a strong focus on C#.
  • Proficient in .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices, event driven architecture and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud for development and deployment.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Technical Services Manager (SAP ECS)
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Be the primary technical contact for customers, guiding them through their SAP journey.

title: Engineer (Pleno) Machine Learning/Gen AI
description:
Vaga 100% Remota - Engenheiro(a) de Machine Learning/GenAI (Pleno)


Estamos à procura de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Machine Learning / GenAI (Pleno) talentoso(a) e proativo(a) para atuar no desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e IA Generativa que irão transformar diferentes áreas de negócio da empresa. Se você é apaixonado(a) por modelos de linguagem, orquestração e inovação com IA, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!


Descrição da Função


O(a) profissional será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções robustas de Machine Learning e IA Generativa aplicadas a desafios de negócio. Isso inclui a criação e otimização de pipelines de dados e modelos, integração fluida com APIs e sistemas corporativos, e a automação de fluxos inteligentes utilizando frameworks modernos de orquestração.


Responsabilidades Chave


  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções de IA: Projetar e implantar soluções de IA/ML, com foco em modelos generativos (LLMs).


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Implementar e otimizar workflows complexos utilizando frameworks como LangChain e LangGraph para orquestração de agentes e modelos.


  • Pipeline de Dados e Modelos: Construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes para ingestão, pré-processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.


  • Integração e Escalabilidade: Integrar modelos de IA a APIs, microsserviços e sistemas corporativos, garantindo a entrega de soluções escaláveis e performáticas.


  • Colaboração Estratégica: Colaborar ativamente com áreas de negócio (marketing, vendas, operações) para identificar e capitalizar oportunidades de inovação com IA.


  • Qualidade e Ética: Garantir segurança, compliance e as melhores práticas éticas em todas as soluções de IA desenvolvidas.


  • Otimização de LLMs: Aplicar técnicas avançadas de prompt engineering e fine-tuning para maximizar o desempenho dos LLMs.


  • Monitoramento: Monitorar e otimizar modelos em produção quanto à precisão, latência e custo.


  • Documentação: Documentar arquiteturas, fluxos de trabalho e melhores práticas para promover reuso e padronização.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)


  • Linguagem e Processamento de Dados: Domínio de SQL e ferramentas de processamento de dados como PySpark e Pandas .


  • Plataformas Cloud: Experiência prática em plataformas de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP ) e seus respectivos serviços de IA/ML.


  • ML/Data Platform: Familiaridade com Databricks ou plataformas equivalentes de dados e Machine Learning.


  • Integração: Conhecimento sólido em integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais Desejáveis


  • Experiência comprovada com LLMs , LangChain , LangGraph ou arquitetura de orquestração multiagente.


  • Conhecimento e vivência em arquitetura de MLOps e deploy de modelos em ambientes de produção.


  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade de IA (ex: MLflow, Weights & Biases).


  • Inglês técnico para leitura e documentação.



Nível de Experiência e Formação


  • Formação: Superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos de vivência profissional (perfil Pleno+).

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience and strong problem-solving abilities, quickly learn new technologies and concepts, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. The client provides industry-leading software for environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance in the retail and commercial fuel industry. Their platform helps major fuel networks, including global brands, monitor and optimize their operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tech Lead Java - Engenharia de Plataforma
description:
Buscamos um(a) Tech Lead experiente e pragmático(a) para liderar equipes estratégicas em nosso projeto de transformação digital. Você será a espinha dorsal técnica, responsável por guiar uma equipe de Engenharia de Plataforma, construindo a fundação robusta, segura e escalável sobre a qual nossos produtos serão modernizados. Simultaneamente, liderará uma squad de Modernização, aplicando as melhores práticas e as ferramentas da plataforma para entregar um produto de alto valor.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Habilitar e acelerar o desenvolvimento das outras equipes através de uma plataforma, ao mesmo tempo em que lidera pelo exemplo, demonstrando como utilizar essa plataforma para modernizar nossos domínios de negócio.
  • Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver tecnicamente os membros das squads.
  • Ser a referência técnica da squad, conduzindo decisões de arquitetura, boas práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Projetar, construir e manter a arquitetura da nossa plataforma de contêineres on-premises (Kubernetes), garantindo alta disponibilidade, observabilidade e segurança.
  • Contribuir e evoluir os pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), estratégias de branching e de deploy para todo o projeto.
  • Colaborar diretamente com os especialistas em DevOps, DevSecOps e SRE para implementar as melhores práticas de entrega, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Garantir a aplicação de padrões de arquitetura e código (Microserviços e microfrontends) em ambas as equipes.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e assumindo responsabilidade, resolvendo impedimentos complexos e garantindo a saúde e a qualidade técnica das soluções.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Sólida experiência como Tech Lead ou Engenheiro Sênior.
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Habilidade para escrever documentação técnica detalhada e padronizada.
  • Domínio em Java (17 e 21) e no ecossistema Spring.
  • Experiência prévia liderando times de plataforma, SRE ou DevOps.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes para orquestração de containers, deploy escaláveis e gerenciamento de aplicações distribuídas.
  • Vivência prática com ferramentas de CI/CD, preferencialmente Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle), modelagem e soluções de caching (Redis) e mensageria (RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento com desenvolvimento Frontend moderno (TypeScript, React, Next.js).
  • Familiaridade com os princípios de Arquitetura Hexagonal, EDA, SOLID, DDD e Design Patterns.
  • Vivência com testes de stress, tunning de performance.


Informações Adicionais

  • Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho Remoto;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;
  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

title: Senior/Mid Software Engineer
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for 1 responsible and proactive Mid professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and most of the communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



You Might be thinking:


What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Java expertise, service/server development
  • Proven experience with the Spring framework
  • Familiarity with at least one of the main cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Proven experience with Web development and REST API
  • Docker expertise
  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • If you have familiarity with Azure and EntraID or an understanding of web security it will be a plus.
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD), will also be a plus


As Contractor (PJ) you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Senior Rust Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Rust Software Engineer to deliver high-quality, high-performance systems. You'll be writing Rust-first code to tackle complex systems challenges, acting as a technical leader on client projects, and independently designing robust, scalable, and memory-safe solutions. You will champion best practices and elevate the engineering bar for mission-critical applications:


Must-have skills:

- Expert-level proficiency in the Rust programming language, including a deep understanding of core concepts like the Ownership Model, Borrow Checker, Lifetimes, Traits, and Macros.

- Strong background in systems programming concepts, including multithreading, concurrent programming, and performance-critical application development.

- Extensive experience with asynchronous programming in Rust, particularly using frameworks like Tokio and understanding the nuances of async/await.

- Proven experience designing and implementing highly scalable backend services and distributed systems.

- Proficiency with the Rust toolchain, including Cargo , and strong experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of tackling and resolving complex architectural and coding challenges.


Nice-to-haves:

- Ideal experience working with video processing related projects with real time systems and web containers.

- Ideal experience utilizing webRTC , real time system response, publishing on multiple platforms.


The icing on the Kake:

  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: COLLEGE SPORTS (College Football & College Basketball) SOCIAL EDITOR
description:
COLLEGE SPORTS (College Football & College Basketball) SOCIAL EDITOR


JOB SUMMARY

College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) social media editors are content creators who manage ClutchPoints’ College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) social pages across Facebook, Instagram, X, and Tiktok. These professionals work within the marketing and communications department and closely follow the company's brand voice, image, and guidelines.



GOALS AND DUTIES

  • Manage the conceptualization and creation of content for all of ClutchPoints' College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) social media brands
  • Build monthly engagement/reach across ClutchPoints’ College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) social pages
  • Be a diehard College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) fan
  • Be able to think differently/creatively
  • Acquire timely information from relevant sources
  • Maintain quality control of all posts and campaigns
  • Be organized and be able to manage multiple social pages
  • Willing to learn photoshop (bonus: photoshop experience) to cover breaking news
  • Be able to find relevant and timely College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) information.
  • Be able to come up with creative photo poster/video highlight ideas using the said College Sports (College Football & College Basketball) information.
  • Be able to write creative captions for our social media fans.
  • Must have general knowledge about College Sports (College Football & College Basketball).



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be able to work at least 40 hours a week max
  • Must be a sports fan with expertise on the College Sports (College Football & College Basketball)
  • Must be social media savvy
  • Weekend/night availability (especially on gamedays)
  • Must have native/bilingual proficiency in English and can easily spot any written

English errors (spelling/grammar/wording/etc.).

- You must take an English proficiency exam to test your English skill level (score > 90).

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Engenheiro de Integração de Dados Sênior (AE)
description:
Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (DE)


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Estruturar e manter os processos de ingestão de dados de múltiplos serviços, sistemas e fontes externas da plataforma, focando em alta performance e qualidade dos dados;

• Entender profundamente a plataforma técnica para identificar novas fontes e evoluções necessárias, com suporte do time de tecnologia;

• Você será a “Força” do time de Engenharia de Dados dentro dos squads de tecnologia e deve ser capaz de entregar de ponta a ponta as demandas específicas, alinhando processos, dependências e suporte com o time do CoE de Dados;

• Criação e sustentação de pipelines de integração dos dados do ambiente de produção por CDC;

• Otimização do processamento dos dados para alta disponibilidade;

• Soluções de integração de dados externos (parceiros e outros sistemas), via API, FTP ou consumo direto de flat files;

• Orquestração de todas as dependências (pré e pós) e garantida de entrega;

• Mapeamento de evolução da plataforma de dados e adequação a novas implementações técnicas;

• Manutenção de Estruturas de Dados para consumo específico, como Data Marts e Feature Stores;

• Implementação das regras globais de arquitetura e governança de dados.


O que você precisa ter

• Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;

• Cloud Computing | Azure, AWS, GCP;

• Workflow | Control-M e/ou AirFlow;

• Storage Solutions | Redshift, Parquet, Delta;

• Estatística | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, testes de hipótese, regressão;

• Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;

• Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;

• SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;

• Dremio, Looker, Metabase ou outras plataformas de Self-Service de dados | Para se colocar sempre no lugar do cliente;

• Python ou R | Para quando a coisa fica bem séria;

• Scala & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;

• Inglês e/ou Espanhol intermediário ou superior – Obrigatório.


Será um diferencial seu perfil com:

• Ter instalado ferramentas de integração de dados (on premisses ou cloud);

• Atuado na administração de ferramentas (on premisses ou cloud);

• Capacidade para fazer troubleshooting em erros de conexão/conectividade;

• Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;

• Aplicação de TOGAF, DAMA ou frameworks de arquitetura similares;

• Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;

• Compreensão dos diferentes tipos de protocolo HTTP, AMQP, TCP, TLS;

• Conhecimento e utilização de ferramentas para APM, Observabilidade, Monitoria e Logging (ex.: NewRelic, Dynatrace, Datadog, ELK, etc.);

• Experiência no trabalho com Containers, em especial, Kubernetes.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Benefícios para você:

• Vale Refeição.

• Vale Alimentação.

• Assistência Médica.

• Assistência Odontológica.

• Seguro de Vida.

• Gym Pass.

• Auxílio Pet.


Além disso, oferecemos:

• Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian.

• Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos.

• Formação através da Trilha de Liderança.

• SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;

• Dremio, Looker, Metabase ou outras plataformas de Self-Service de dados | Para se colocar sempre no lugar do cliente;

• Python ou R | Para quando a coisa fica bem séria;

• Scala & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;

• Inglês e/ou Espanhol intermediário ou superior – Obrigatório.


Será um diferencial seu perfil com:

• Ter instalado ferramentas de integração de dados (on premisses ou cloud);

• Atuado na administração de ferramentas (on premisses ou cloud);

• Capacidade para fazer troubleshooting em erros de conexão/conectividade;

• Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;

• Aplicação de TOGAF, DAMA ou frameworks de arquitetura similares;

• Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;

• Compreensão dos diferentes tipos de protocolo HTTP, AMQP, TCP, TLS;

• Conhecimento e utilização de ferramentas para APM, Observabilidade, Monitoria e Logging (ex.: NewRelic, Dynatrace, Datadog, ELK, etc.);

• Experiência no trabalho com Containers, em especial, Kubernetes.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Benefícios para você:

• Vale Refeição.

• Vale Alimentação.

• Assistência Médica.

• Assistência Odontológica.

• Seguro de Vida.

• Gym Pass.

• Auxílio Pet.


Além disso, oferecemos:

• Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian.

• Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos.

• Formação através da Trilha de Liderança.

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.
