title: Senior UI Designer - Part time
description:
Client location: Remote (EST hours required)

Type: On-Demand / Part time Placement (Long-term, multi-year engagement possible)


Overview

We are seeking an experienced UI Designer to join our design team in an on-demand capacity. This position supports overflow project work, ad hoc design needs, and team coverage during PTO. While the work will vary depending on client and project demands, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to strategic, high-impact design initiatives.

This is not a freelance, flexible-hour role, candidates must be available full-time during EST working hours to collaborate with internal and client teams, attend meetings, and deliver design solutions as needed. Open to be worked remotely in any south American country


Key Responsibilities

  • Support active design projects as needed during staff PTO and overflow periods.
  • Mentor and guide other UI Designers.
  • Define and implement visual direction for project rollouts.
  • Develop and maintain design systems and style guides.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles with clients and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the strategic vision of the user experience.
  • Lead design reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Participate in project planning and scoping activities.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and developer specifications.
  • Conduct user research and analyze user feedback.
  • Ensure designs are accessible and adhere to WCAG and usability standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on project goals and timelines.
  • Communicate design decisions effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Follow Curio’s Figma Etiquette for all design files.
  • Maintain design consistency across products and platforms.
  • Stay current with Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Design Best Practices.


Typical Tasks

  • Design support for Proof of Concepts (POCs) and RFPs.
  • Contribution to case studies and internal initiatives.
  • Long-term design maintenance and system updates.


Required Skills

Primary Skills

  • Expertise in Figma (including advanced component systems).
  • Strong understanding of Apple HIG, Google Material Design, and web design best practices.
  • Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Skilled in design presentation and client communication.

Secondary Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Animation and motion design.
  • Video editing and print design.
  • 3D modeling, AI/AR/VR experience.
  • User research and usability testing.
  • Webflow or front-end development experience.

Soft Skills

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly proactive and self-motivated.
  • Naturally inquisitive – asks “why” to understand user and business goals.
  • Clear, concise communication (no tangents or offshoots).
  • Confident and independent decision-making ability.


Qualifications

  • Strong portfolios and hands-on experience will be prioritized.
  • Must provide an online portfolio and Figma samples for team review.


Professional Development

  • Annual review of Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Best Practices.
  • Ongoing skill development through Figma training and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

This is not a freelance, flexible-hour role, candidates must be available full-time during EST working hours to collaborate with internal and client teams, attend meetings, and deliver design solutions as needed. Open to be worked remotely in any south American country


Key Responsibilities

  • Support active design projects as needed during staff PTO and overflow periods.
  • Mentor and guide other UI Designers.
  • Define and implement visual direction for project rollouts.
  • Develop and maintain design systems and style guides.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles with clients and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the strategic vision of the user experience.
  • Lead design reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Participate in project planning and scoping activities.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and developer specifications.
  • Conduct user research and analyze user feedback.
  • Ensure designs are accessible and adhere to WCAG and usability standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on project goals and timelines.
  • Communicate design decisions effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Follow Curio’s Figma Etiquette for all design files.
  • Maintain design consistency across products and platforms.
  • Stay current with Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Design Best Practices.


Typical Tasks

  • Design support for Proof of Concepts (POCs) and RFPs.
  • Contribution to case studies and internal initiatives.
  • Long-term design maintenance and system updates.


Required Skills

Primary Skills

  • Expertise in Figma (including advanced component systems).
  • Strong understanding of Apple HIG, Google Material Design, and web design best practices.
  • Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Skilled in design presentation and client communication.

Secondary Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Animation and motion design.
  • Video editing and print design.
  • 3D modeling, AI/AR/VR experience.
  • User research and usability testing.
  • Webflow or front-end development experience.

Soft Skills

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly proactive and self-motivated.
  • Naturally inquisitive – asks “why” to understand user and business goals.
  • Clear, concise communication (no tangents or offshoots).
  • Confident and independent decision-making ability.


Qualifications

  • Strong portfolios and hands-on experience will be prioritized.
  • Must provide an online portfolio and Figma samples for team review.


Professional Development

  • Annual review of Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Best Practices.
  • Ongoing skill development through Figma training and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Buscamos Business Analyst para atuar em uma grande empresa do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional.

O profissional será responsável por apoiar o desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas voltadas à refatoração de processos estruturais , participando da definição de estratégias, priorização de demandas e melhoria de processos de negócio junto às áreas técnicas e operacionais, garantindo escalabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança das soluções.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, operações e tecnologia , traduzindo necessidades em soluções efetivas.
  • Definir e priorizar demandas , acompanhando o ciclo de vida de produtos e processos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento de roadmaps e iniciativas estratégicas.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre stakeholders, garantindo entendimento comum das entregas.
  • Analisar métricas e indicadores (KPIs e OKRs) para direcionar decisões de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) , colaborando com squads multidisciplinares


O que você precisa ter

  • Perfil business-driven , com entendimento do dia a dia de áreas de negócio e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade de documentar, comunicar e compartilhar conhecimento com os times.
  • Atitude de dono , buscando as melhores práticas e entregas de alto impacto.
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva , atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Raciocínio lógico, senso crítico e agilidade na resolução de problemas.
  • Proatividade e colaboração em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Vivência em gestão de produtos e stakeholders.
  • Experiência em intake de demandas , ajudando a definir visão e objetivos de produtos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos e histórias técnicas .
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) .
  • Experiência com definição e acompanhamento de métricas e objetivos (KPIs e OKRs) .
  • Habilidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis organizacionais .

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Gerenciado portfólio de multi-projetos/demandas/iniciativas de diferentes tamanhos e prioridades;
  • Capacidade de realizar negociação de escopo em iniciativas multidisciplinares;
  • Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;
  • Habilidade em escrita técnica;
  • Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes financeiros.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

title: FBS Associate Business Analyst
description:
Description

Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premium well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

Location: Brazil/Mexico – Working Hours: 8:00 am to 5:00 pm (EST)

What You’ll Do:

  • Production Support : Troubleshooting issues on Comparative Rater vendor platforms and Download to maintain seamless operations.
  • Collaboration : Working closely with Distribution Teams, IT, and external vendors to align on solutions and improvements.
  • Enhancements & Development : Driving service enhancements and supporting the launch of new products on the Comparative Rater and Download platform.
  • Download Services : Facilitating the delivery of policy transaction details to agents via their agency management systems, enabling effective customer service.

Requirements

Experience:

· 3 years of experience.

Skills:

· Proficiency in English (Interview’ll be in English)

· Bachelor's degree Business Administration.


· Excel – Intermediate


· Office Suite - Intermediate


· Power BI - Entry Level


· Project Management Tools - Entry Level


· Insurance Knowledge - Preferred


Benefits

1. Competitive compensation and benefits package:

2. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses

3. Comprehensive benefits package

4. Career development and training opportunities

5. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)

6. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group

7. Private Health Insurance

8. Pension Plan

9. Paid Time Off

10. Training & Development

11. Performance Bonus

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

title: Concierge
description:
Somos uma EdTech com foco em processos de saúde. Temos o compromisso de melhorar a educação médica do Brasil, com o propósito de melhorar o cuidado ao paciente em todos os níveis de acesso do sistema de saúde. Somos também um time que acredita a inovação e a tecnologia devem ser aliadas da educação em um meio que está em constante atualizações, por isso, estamos cada vez mais ampliando as oportunidades de talentos na equipe, com desejo de transformar, melhorar e ativamente criar este ecossistema conosco.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar atendimento via chat ou outras plataformas de comunicação;
  • Auxiliar os clientes com dúvidas ou problemas técnicos relacionados ao produto, ou serviço;
  • Compreender a solicitação do cliente e atendê-la de forma ágil e solicita;
  • Responder reclamações no site do Reclame Aqui;
  • Realizar onboarding com novos alunos;
  • Realizar chamada de vídeo com alunos, quando necessário para explicar/apresentar a plataforma.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, tanto escrita quanto verbal;
  • Facilidade em utilizar sistemas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão de chamados;
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma rápida e eficaz, mantendo a calma em situações desafiadoras;
  • Empatia e paciência para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proatividade, vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Conhecimento básico de informática (Excel).


Desejável:

  • Curso ou experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e/ou Customer Success (CS).


Benefícios :

title: ORACLE - Cloud FIN - TAX
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for ORACLE - Cloud FIN - TAX, Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Must-Have:

Broad experience in cloud implementations & support

Senior resources with hands-to-keyboard capabilities to configure Oracle Cloud TAX for Brazil localization

Oracle Cloud tax configuration, calculation, and management of required company registration numbers

Very good understanding of Brazil related localization in Oracle cloud


Good-to-Have

Able to work independently with customer

Agile way of working


Responsibility of / Expectations from the Role

Oracle Cloud Financial Modules – Support

Issue resolution and fix

Collaborate and meeting with users to understand the issue

Work with Oracle on Service request

Work with Global Support team located in India and collaborate for smooth issue resolution

Period close activities

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo


A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.


Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.


Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.


Conheça + sobre a posição nesse link:



Qual a missão do Cargo?

Realizar desenvolvimento de microserviços e API em java.


Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Ajudar outras pessoas do time com dúvidas de negócio e tecnologia;
  • Ajudar arquiteto com pequenas alterações em documentação e processos;
  • Destreza para falar com o cliente de forma clara e segura;
  • Tomar iniciativa para resolver questões do dia a dia do time;
  • Participação de ritos com nossos clientes;
  • Interação com os Arquitetos do time para compreensão da solução de negócio e técnica;
  • Levantamento das atividades técnicas;
  • Implementação de APIs e microsserviços;
  • Utilizar as melhores práticas de processos de desenvolvimento buscando sempre a qualidade e a melhoria contínua;



Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Microservices;
  • Mandar bem nas versões mais recentes do Java e Spring Boot;
  • Experiência com Banco de Dados Relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Conhecer APIs REST, verbos HTTP e Response Codes;
  • Experiência com SOLID, Padrões de Projeto e Clean Code;
  • Experiência com GitFlow;
  • Experiência com testes unitários;
  • Conhecer SonarQuebe e SonarLint;
  • Experiência com RabbitMq (PublishSubscriber);
  • Experiência com Jenkins;
  • Conhecimentos de Kubernetes/Openshift;
  • Vivência com BDD e TDD;
  • Vivência com Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery;
  • Vivência em projetos com Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);



Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Vivência com cultura DevOps;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud;
  • Experiência com meios de pagamento e/ou financeiro



Aqui você vai encontrar:


Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.


Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.


Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.


Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)



Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

title: Business Analyst - 45430
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Lead Analyst / Content Team Lead to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models with no AI experience required. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).


What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No AI experience required
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.


Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Community Manager (English-Fluent / Bilingual)
description:
We’re looking for a dedicated and passionate Community Manager to help us cultivate and grow a strong, engaged, and purpose-driven community. You will be the face and heart of our community. Because our audience is global, you must be fully comfortable communicating in English — from writing to speaking to moderating.


If you love connecting people, sparking conversations, and building relationships that matter — this role is for you.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and manage our online community across platforms
  • Create engagement strategies and community initiatives
  • Foster meaningful relationships and ensure a positive experience for members
  • Collaborate with our marketing team to grow our community presence
  • Represent the voice of the community and share insights with the team
  • Ensure every member interaction reflects our mission and values


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong leadership mindset — able to take initiative and work independently
  • Exceptional written and verbal English skills—fluency is required.
  • Creative, strategic, and resourceful thinker
  • Experience or strong interest in community management, engagement, or brand building


Who We Are:

Acadium is on a mission to accelerate careers and grow businesses through real-world marketing apprenticeships. With over 300,000 users and growing, we're reinventing how people launch marketing careers—and how small businesses grow with them.


Why Join Acadium?

  • A mission-driven team changing how people start their careers.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly culture with ownership and autonomy.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based bonuses.
  • Work closely with founders and marketing leadership on high-impact projects.
  • Fast-moving team where great ideas don’t need permission to get executed.


Join us in building something impactful — a community where people connect, learn, and grow together.


Application Requirement

Please ensure your profile, CV, and all submitted materials are in English format.

Because our audience is global, you must be fully comfortable communicating in English — from writing to speaking to moderating.


If you love connecting people, sparking conversations, and building relationships that matter — this role is for you.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and manage our online community across platforms
  • Create engagement strategies and community initiatives
  • Foster meaningful relationships and ensure a positive experience for members
  • Collaborate with our marketing team to grow our community presence
  • Represent the voice of the community and share insights with the team
  • Ensure every member interaction reflects our mission and values


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong leadership mindset — able to take initiative and work independently
  • Exceptional written and verbal English skills—fluency is required.
  • Creative, strategic, and resourceful thinker
  • Experience or strong interest in community management, engagement, or brand building


Who We Are:

Acadium is on a mission to accelerate careers and grow businesses through real-world marketing apprenticeships. With over 300,000 users and growing, we're reinventing how people launch marketing careers—and how small businesses grow with them.


Why Join Acadium?

  • A mission-driven team changing how people start their careers.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly culture with ownership and autonomy.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based bonuses.
  • Work closely with founders and marketing leadership on high-impact projects.
  • Fast-moving team where great ideas don’t need permission to get executed.


Join us in building something impactful — a community where people connect, learn, and grow together.


Application Requirement

Please ensure your profile, CV, and all submitted materials are in English format.

title: Content Creator, C2 English Required (Remote)
description:
CONTENT CREATOR NEEDED, C2 ENGLISH FLUENCY IS A MUST.


Who we Are:

Mint Maintenance is a residential and commercial cleaning company based in Boston, MA, that creates cleaner living spaces to unleash your productive power and improve your health and wellbeing. Our team is small, naturally curious, and obsessed with exceeding industry standards and providing memorable experiences. We are now seeking a Video Content Creator to join our team to help expand our digital reach and resonate with more audiences.



Role Overview:

The Content Creator will be creating 1-4 minute video clips of themselves, explaining how we undertake our services. All scripts will be provided to you. These videos will be displayed across our business assets. You will not be using any of your personal accounts for this role.

Our ideal candidate is someone who is adaptable to feedback, has an iPhone with reliable quality (you will be using this device to record all videos), and speaks with an enunciated and animated tone. No previous experience is required. If you're interested in being considered, please send a brief video to introducing yourself.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity

We are looking for Backend Engineers (Golang) to join Cloudflare’s Billing Engineering team , a critical group responsible for powering all internal and external billing services — including customer onboarding, subscription management, payments, provisioning, and integrations with enterprise systems such as Anaplan, Oracle, Workday, and NetSuite .

We are seeking engineers who can ramp up quickly and deliver impact from day one. The team works in a modern, container-based, microservices environment built primarily in Golang , using Kafka, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL at scale.


You’ll be part of a collaborative 6-member team with additional developers supporting from adjacent projects. The environment promotes mentorship, knowledge sharing, and autonomy — you’ll never be left alone, but you’ll have the space to take ownership and drive meaningful results.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Golang-based microservices that power Cloudflare’s billing systems.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs that interface with external financial and operational systems.
  • Work with event-driven systems and streaming architectures using Kafka .
  • Manage containerized deployments using Kubernetes and Docker .
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across teams to deliver new features and maintain operational excellence.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across distributed systems.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture planning sessions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of system reliability, scalability, and security.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional backend development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Golang (or proven ability to quickly ramp up).
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend microservices.
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
  • Proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker for container orchestration and deployment.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems (Kafka or similar).
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with multiple stakeholders.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience integrating with ERP systems such as Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or NetSuite .
  • Familiarity with API standards and tools (Swagger/OpenAPI, OAuth, JWT).
  • Exposure to Temporal or similar orchestration tools.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems , security best practices , and observability .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Passion for building reliable, scalable, and user-centric systems at global scale.


Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
⚙️ We’re Hiring – DevOps Engineer

Location: (Insert Remote/Hybrid/Onsite – as applicable)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: Senior-level


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our team and support large-scale cloud operations across multiple providers and SaaS solutions. This role involves supporting high-visibility events (such as major live broadcasts and global digital launches) and contributing to the delivery of key product updates, infrastructure improvements, and business continuity initiatives.

You’ll be responsible for managing cloud infrastructure, ensuring security and compliance, optimizing performance and cost, and driving automation across the DevOps lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and manage cloud-based infrastructure across AWS and other providers.
  • Lead migrations from EC2 to Kubernetes-native environments .
  • Support large-scale live and product events with reliable, scalable DevOps practices.
  • Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) and DevOps automation to streamline deployments.
  • Manage security response, incident management , and compliance across systems.
  • Maintain observability and monitoring frameworks for critical services.
  • Optimize cloud spend and ensure cost-efficient resource utilization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance application delivery , load balancing , caching , and backend performance .
  • Support frontend (CDN/load balancing) and backend (DB/caching) delivery management.
  • Contribute to Agile development cycles and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience in DevOps engineering and cloud infrastructure management .
  • Expertise with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Kubernetes .
  • Strong experience with serverless technologies and container orchestration .
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and automation frameworks .
  • Solid understanding of observability, configuration management , and system monitoring.
  • Experience with security response, compliance, and incident resolution .
  • Knowledge of frontend delivery (CDN, load balancing) and backend management (DB, caching) .
  • Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and development lifecycle management .

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with multi-cloud environments and SaaS administration.
  • Experience in governance , cost optimization , and compliance management .
  • Understanding of application workloads , both frontend and backend.

title: BizOps
description:
Você é um(a) profissional que une pensamento analítico, visão estratégica e paixão por eficiência?

Se você tem domínio em automação, dados e otimização de processos de negócio, esta é a sua chance de impactar diretamente a operação da Ticto.


Como Você Pode Colaborar:

  • Mapear e automatizar processos internos, conectando áreas como Marketing, Vendas, CS, Financeiro e Produto.
  • Criar integrações entre ferramentas (CRM, ERP, plataformas de atendimento, automação de marketing, etc.).
  • Construir fluxos automatizados que aumentem produtividade e garantam dados consistentes em toda a operação.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para entender gargalos e propor soluções inteligentes e escaláveis.
  • Estruturar pipelines de dados, acompanhar KPIs e criar alertas e dashboards para suporte à decisão.
  • Documentar e manter soluções com foco em reutilização, governança e escalabilidade.


O Que Estamos Buscando:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier) ou scripts em Python/Node.js.
  • Domínio de SQL e integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Vivência com plataformas como Hubspot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zendesk ou Intercom.
  • Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Organização e habilidade de documentar e estruturar processos com clareza.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados (dbt, Airbyte, Supabase, Postgres).
  • Noções de análise e visualização de dados (Metabase, Looker).
  • Familiaridade com versionamento (Git) e background em Produto ou Engenharia.


✨ Na Ticto, você terá a oportunidade de deixar sua marca, impactando diretamente a criação de uma experiência de cliente inesquecível.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot com IA Generativa (Dialogflow)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar.


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h, com flexibilidade conforme agendas e entregas
  • Etapas do Processo: composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 3 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra
  • Meios de Comunicação: utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot com IA Generativa (Dialogflow) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por criar e evoluir experiências conversacionais inteligentes, conectando diferentes sistemas e aplicando técnicas de IA e NLP para tornar as interações cada vez mais naturais, precisas e eficientes.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver APIs para conectar o chatbot a sistemas externos, utilizando Node.js e Python
  • Criar e gerenciar webhooks para processamento e retorno de informações
  • Implementar lógicas de negócio e regras de decisão personalizadas para fluxos conversacionais
  • Criar e configurar intents, entities e fluxos conversacionais no Dialogflow
  • Desenvolver interfaces conversacionais com IA generativa, utilizando prompts, playbooks e técnicas de NLP
  • Integrar o chatbot com diferentes canais de comunicação (Web, WhatsApp e outros)
  • Realizar testes, monitoramento e otimização do desempenho do chatbot
  • Colaborar com times de produto e design para aprimorar continuamente a experiência do usuário.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com Node.js e Python
  • Conhecimento em Dialogflow (criação e configuração de intents, entities e fulfillment)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful e integrações com sistemas externos
  • Vivência com webhooks, processamento de dados e regras de negócio
  • Conhecimento em NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural)
  • Controle de versão com Git.


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com OpenAI API, LangChain ou outras ferramentas de IA generativa
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos com chatbots multi-canais (WhatsApp, Messenger, Webchat etc.)
  • Possuir vivência com frameworks de automação conversacional
  • Demonstrar curiosidade, proatividade e vontade de aprender novas tecnologias.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders:

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju — um valor flexível para você usar como quiser
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata, apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders
  • Assistência Odontológica Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental — acesso ao aplicativo Vida+
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física — acesso ao aplicativo Gympass
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar.


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h, com flexibilidade conforme agendas e entregas
  • Etapas do Processo: composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 3 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra
  • Meios de Comunicação: utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot com IA Generativa (Dialogflow) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por criar e evoluir experiências conversacionais inteligentes, conectando diferentes sistemas e aplicando técnicas de IA e NLP para tornar as interações cada vez mais naturais, precisas e eficientes.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver APIs para conectar o chatbot a sistemas externos, utilizando Node.js e Python
  • Criar e gerenciar webhooks para processamento e retorno de informações
  • Implementar lógicas de negócio e regras de decisão personalizadas para fluxos conversacionais
  • Criar e configurar intents, entities e fluxos conversacionais no Dialogflow
  • Desenvolver interfaces conversacionais com IA generativa, utilizando prompts, playbooks e técnicas de NLP
  • Integrar o chatbot com diferentes canais de comunicação (Web, WhatsApp e outros)
  • Realizar testes, monitoramento e otimização do desempenho do chatbot
  • Colaborar com times de produto e design para aprimorar continuamente a experiência do usuário.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com Node.js e Python
  • Conhecimento em Dialogflow (criação e configuração de intents, entities e fulfillment)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful e integrações com sistemas externos
  • Vivência com webhooks, processamento de dados e regras de negócio
  • Conhecimento em NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural)
  • Controle de versão com Git.


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com OpenAI API, LangChain ou outras ferramentas de IA generativa
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos com chatbots multi-canais (WhatsApp, Messenger, Webchat etc.)
  • Possuir vivência com frameworks de automação conversacional
  • Demonstrar curiosidade, proatividade e vontade de aprender novas tecnologias.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders:

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju — um valor flexível para você usar como quiser
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata, apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders
  • Assistência Odontológica Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental — acesso ao aplicativo Vida+
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física — acesso ao aplicativo Gympass
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Our partner is entering its next phase of growth, expanding their platform and building intelligent systems that transform how banks and credit unions understand and serve their small business customers. They’re looking for a Data Engineer to own their data universe, keeping it clean, reliable, and ready to power every part of the business. They will maintain and evolve their data infrastructure, integrate new data sources, and ensure systems stay accurate and up to date. This hands-on role is for someone who loves end to end data engineering, from designing schemas and managing ETL pipelines to sourcing and evaluating new datasets. They will work closely with engineers and data scientists to bring high-quality data into production, enabling new features and insights. They will have broad ownership with real impact from day one.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes that keep databases accurate and up to date.
  • Own the structure, quality, and reliability of their core datasets.
  • Source, evaluate, and integrate new public and private data sources, including APIs and bulk datasets.
  • Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to deliver clean, well-structured data into their products.
  • Monitor and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability.
  • Define best practices for data governance, validation, and maintenance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of their data infrastructure and tooling roadmap.


What You Bring:

  • Strong experience designing, building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL processes.
  • Deep understanding of relational databases and data modeling (PostgreSQL or similar).
  • Experience ingesting and integrating data from multiple external sources, including APIs.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data environments.
  • Ability to evaluate new datasets for quality, coverage, and business value.
  • Comfort working in small, fast-moving teams with limited technical oversight.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset.


Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with financial data, entity resolution, or business intelligence systems.
  • Familiarity with data orchestration tools.
  • Background in data quality monitoring or data observability frameworks.
  • Fintech or data-heavy SaaS experience.


What You’ll Get:

  • The opportunity to build and own the data foundation of a high-growth startup.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Fully remote work model, with the opportunity to occasionally collaborate in-person.
  • Fast-moving, engaging environment with a team that values both ambition and fun.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to make a huge impact in an early-stage company defining a new category in financial technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Vendedor
description:
Vendedor X1 – Conversão de Leads

(Casa de Aposta | Operação de Alta Performance)


Descrição:

Estamos montando uma operação agressiva de conversão de leads para uma grande casa de apostas.

Você será responsável por transformar apostadores cadastrados em apostadores ativos, incentivando o primeiro depósito e garantindo volume e constância.


Temos uma base própria de +4 milhões de jogadores cadastrados.

Cada novo depósito realizado gera retorno direto para a operação.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil de vendas de alta energia, foco em metas e que goste de ritmo acelerado e meritocracia.


Responsabilidades:


  • Abordar leads quentes, mornos e frios por WhatsApp e ligação (base fornecida).
  • Incentivar o primeiro depósito com argumentação convincente.
  • Realizar até 100 conversões por dia com acompanhamento via CRM.
  • Reduzir desistências e no-shows com follow-up ativo.
  • Testar mensagens, scripts e abordagens para aumentar conversão.
  • Reportar métricas diárias de performance (taxa de contato, conversão e ticket médio).


Remuneração:


  • Fixo competitivo (R$ 2.000 – R$ 2.500).
  • Comissão por conversão (por depósito realizado).
  • Bônus por performance semanal e meta batida.


Modelo:


  • 100 % remoto.
  • Segunda a sábado (horário comercial, com flexibilidade).

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno e Sênior
description:
A Logus procura um programador de computador de alto nível com raciocínios lógico e abstrato apurados, e alto poder de concentração, de atitude profissional madura, respeitosa com seus pares e no trato com os clientes. Será responsável por desenvolver aplicações utilizando a plataforma Java Enterprise Edition sobre bancos de dados relacionais dos diversos fabricantes disponíveis no mercado e trabalhará na manutenção e evolução de produtos de software já existentes e na criação de novos produtos. O contato com os clientes pode se dar de forma eventual ou frequente. O trabalho em equipe é cotidiano e majoritariamente remoto.


﻿Perfil Exigido:

  • Superior Completo, na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou qualquer curso superior com especialização na área de TI lato ou strictu sensu;


Habilidades:

  • Programação Java - J2EE;
  • HTML e CSS;
  • JPA;
  • Experiência em Jboss / Tomcat;
  • Experiência com testes unitários;
  • Elaboração de MER (Modelo Entidade Relacionamento);
  • Estruturas de banco de dados;
  • SQL Ansi;
  • Modelos UML;
  • Aplicação de metodologias de desenvolvimento;
  • Estruturas de dados;
  • Padrão de arquitetura MVC;
  • Desenvolvimento WEB;
  • Integrações com Web Services;
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (GIT, SVN e etc);
  • Ferramentas de Gestão de Projeto (Jira);
  • Aplicação de Padrões de Projeto Java;
  • Experiência com Framework de Frontend


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas: Construção de aplicações baseadas em Java para ambiente Web e Internet voltadas à Gestão Pública (Planejamento e Execução Orçamentária Contábil e Financeira). O processo de construção de aplicações na Logus baseia-se em Java e inclui a criação de camadas de aplicação, técnicas de modelagem, design orientado a objetos, engenharia de software baseado em componentes (CBSE) e desenvolvimento baseado em componentes (CBD). Exige o conhecimento do que é um Padrão de Projeto e de como utilizá-lo com propriedade.


Benefícios:

  • Modelo de Contratação CLT;
  • Plano de Saúde e odontológico subsidiado (50%) pela empresa para o titular;
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde e odontológico com desconto em folha de pagamento;
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação sem desconto em folha;
  • Seguro de vida em Grupo;
  • Bônus Home Office;
  • Acesso ilimitado e gratuito à plataforma de cursos Alura;
  • Participação em Programa de Participação de Lucros e Resultados (PLR).


Remuneração:

title: SAP ECC ABAP
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos SAP ABAP Consultant que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Temos alguns requisitos:


  • Fluência em inglês é mandatória para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Forte desenvolvimento ABAP em objetos RICEF: Relatórios (ALV), Interfaces (IDoc/BAPI/CPI-REST), Conversões (programas LTMC/LSMW/ABAP), Melhorias (BADI/Exits/Enh. Spots) e Formulários (SmartForms/Adobe).
  • ABAP orientado a objetos (OO), modularização, visualizações CDS, conceitos básicos de AMDP, desenvolvimento de serviços BOPF/Fiori OData; sólida depuração e ajuste de desempenho (SQL trace/ST05, SAT/SE30, análise de tempo de execução).
  • Experiência em todo o ciclo de vida: design técnico, construção, testes unitários, revisão de código, gerenciamento de transporte (ChaRM/SolMan) e resolução de defeitos em SIT/UAT/hipercare.
  • Sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados SD/MM/FI e pontos de integração; capacidade de traduzir especificações funcionais em soluções técnicas escaláveis e seguir padrões de codificação.



Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Entregar desenvolvimentos e integrações ABAP de alta qualidade, suportando módulos SAP e necessidades de localização;
  • Fornecer suporte e melhorias na produção.
  • Participar de workshops com equipes funcionais; criar Documentos de Design Técnico (TDD), estimativas e planos de construção.
  • Desenvolver e manter objetos RICEF em conformidade com os padrões de nomenclatura, desempenho e segurança; garantir a reutilização e o tratamento/registro de erros adequado.
  • Construir e expor interfaces via IDoc/BAPI/OData/REST; trabalhar com CPI/PI para mapeamentos de middleware e tratamento de erros.
  • Projetar saídas e formulários: SmartForms/Adobe (S/4 Output Management/BRFplus); lidar com código de barras/QR code e arquivamento em PDF.
  • Implementar melhorias via BADIs/Exits e eventos CDS/BOPF; criar frameworks de AIF/erro, trabalhos em segundo plano e controles de spool/impressão.
  • Realizar testes unitários, criar evidências de teste, oferecer suporte a SIT/UAT e resolver defeitos; manter a rastreabilidade em relação aos requisitos.
  • Otimizar o desempenho usando rastreamento SQL e análise de tempo de execução; Refatorar código personalizado para prontidão S/4HANA (Sintático/Funcional).
  • Gerenciar transportes entre ambientes; cumprir os padrões do Solution Manager/ChaRM e de documentação; oferecer suporte ao hypercare e ao KT para dar suporte às equipes.

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: SR Engenharia de Dados
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

  • Liderar a evolução do Data Lake, implementando e otimizando a Arquitetura Medallion (camadas bronze, prata e ouro).
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL escaláveis utilizando o AWS Glue e outros serviços nativos da AWS.
  • Utilizar o AWS S3 para armazenamento de dados e o Athena para consulta de datasets, garantindo eficiência de desempenho.
  • Otimizar fluxos de trabalho com foco em arquivos Parquet para eficiência no processamento e armazenamento.
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards usando ferramentas como AWS Quicksight e Google Looker Studio para gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para alinhar a infraestrutura de dados e entregáveis às necessidades do negócio.
  • Garantir governança robusta, segurança e conformidade de dados em todas as operações.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com Engenharia de Dados, com especialização em arquiteturas de Data Lake e Arquitetura Medallion.
  • Sólida experiência prática com serviços AWS, incluindo Glue, S3 e Athena.
  • Proficiência no manuseio de arquivos Parquet e na otimização de seu uso para armazenamento e consultas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em processos ETL, ferramentas de integração de dados e orquestração de pipelines (ex.: Apache Airflow).
  • Domínio em SQL e Python para processamento e automação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI, como Power BI, Tableau ou similares, para desenvolvimento de dashboards.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de IA Generativa da AWS, especialmente o Amazon Bedrock.
  • Familiaridade com soluções de IA generativa na GCP (Vertex AI, PaLM) e na Azure (Azure OpenAI Service).
  • Compreensão de técnicas de engenharia de prompts e suas aplicações.
  • Certificações em AWS (ex.: AWS Certified Data Analytics, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD para pipelines de dados e Infraestrutura como Código (ex.: Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de atuar em um ambiente rápido e inovador.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Social Sciences SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pleno
description:
Descritivo:

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack com perfil Pleno, que tenha boa base técnica e vontade de crescer. Atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web , integrando front-end (Angular/React) com back-end em .NET .


Informações:

Modelo de trabalho via contrato PJ;

Home Office;


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Angular e/ou React;
  • Conhecimento em C# e .NET / .NET Core;
  • Consumo e criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Noções de HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Experiência com banco de dados SQL (SQL Server, MySQL, ou similar);
  • Uso de Git e ferramentas de versionamento.


Será um diferencial...

  • Conhecimento em framework DevExpress;
  • Experiência com Entity Framework, LINQ e Web Services;
  • Noções de arquitetura MVC / MVVM;
  • Práticas de CI/CD, Azure DevOps ou pipelines de integração;
  • Vivência com Docker e APIs em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP).


Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular e/ou React;
  • Criar e integrar APIs REST utilizando .NET / .NET Core;
  • Implementar boas práticas de versionamento (Git), componentização e testes unitários;
  • Apoiar a definição de arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com o cliente na resolução de problemas técnicos e evolução de funcionalidades;
  • Garantir qualidade, performance e segurança nas entregas.
